title: Compete
subtitle: 「競爭／角逐／爭奪／抗衡」，要先分清是在跟誰競爭、爭甚麼，以及競爭是否激烈或已經勝出。
description: 「競爭／角逐／爭奪／抗衡」，要先分清是在跟誰競爭、爭甚麼，以及競爭是否激烈或已經勝出。

words.example: The two companies rival each other in the smartphone market.
words.exampleZh: 兩間公司在智能手機市場互相競爭。

exercises.original: The two companies compete directly in the smartphone market.
exercises.zh: 兩間公司在智能手機市場直接競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The two companies rival each other in the smartphone market.

options.explanation: two companies + same market 表示明確直接競爭關係。
participate 只表示共同參與，不表示彼此爭市場。
compare 是比較，不表示爭取優勢。
是結果，不表示持續競爭過程。
只表示表現，不表示對手關係。

exercises.original: Two universities compete closely for the same applicants.
exercises.zh: 兩間大學為同一批申請者激烈競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The two universities rival each other for the same applicants.

options.explanation: 同一批 applicants 形成直接對手關係。
oppose 表示反對，並不等於爭取同一申請者。

exercises.original: The new product competes with the market leader in battery life.
exercises.zh: 新產品在電池續航方面與市場領導產品匹敵。
exercises.upgrade: The new product rivals the market leader in battery life.

options.explanation: product + market leader + performance dimension 可自然表示匹敵／競爭。
產品不能以 play 表示市場競爭。
compare 需要不同句法，而且不表示爭勝。
對產品競爭過於字面／激烈。

words.example: Five teams are contending for the championship.
words.exampleZh: 五支隊伍正在角逐冠軍。

exercises.original: Five teams are competing for the championship.
exercises.zh: 五支隊伍正在角逐冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: Five teams are contending for the championship.

options.explanation: championship 是明確競爭目標，contend for 很自然。
某些運動中可說 play for a trophy，但不等於『五隊正角逐』的一般正式表達。
只表示參與比賽，不表示有爭勝意味。
不能同時說五隊都已勝出。

exercises.original: She is competing for a place on the national team.
exercises.zh: 她正在爭取國家隊席位。
exercises.upgrade: She is contending for a place on the national team.

options.explanation: a place 是有限名額，適合正式表示角逐。
compare 不和 for 這樣表示爭奪。
表現可能影響選拔，但不是 compete 的同義。
只參與不足以表達爭取席位。

exercises.original: Several candidates are competing for the leadership position.
exercises.zh: 數名候選人正在角逐領導職位。
exercises.upgrade: Several candidates are contending for the leadership position.

options.explanation: candidates + leadership position 是典型角逐語境。
候選人可互相反對，但不是爭職位的核心。

words.example: Several firms are vying for the government contract.
words.exampleZh: 數間公司正在爭奪政府合約。

exercises.original: Several firms are competing for the government contract.
exercises.zh: 數間公司正在爭奪政府合約。
exercises.upgrade: Several firms are vying for the government contract.

options.explanation: several firms + one desirable contract 是典型多人競逐。

exercises.original: Brands are competing for consumers' attention online.
exercises.zh: 品牌在網上爭奪消費者注意力。
exercises.upgrade: Brands are vying for consumers' attention online.

options.explanation: attention 是 vie for 的非常自然搭配。
品牌競爭不是身體打鬥。
多個品牌不可能同時已贏得全部注意力。

exercises.original: Three cities are competing to host the event.
exercises.zh: 三個城市正競逐主辦活動。
exercises.upgrade: Three cities are vying to host the event.

options.explanation: 多個城市爭同一主辦權，語義自然。
participate 不這樣搭配，且不表示競爭。

words.example: Our team will compete against last year's champions.
words.exampleZh: 我們的隊伍將與去年的冠軍對賽。

exercises.original: Our team will compete with last year's champions tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 我們明天將與去年的冠軍對賽。
exercises.upgrade: Our team will compete against last year's champions tomorrow.

options.explanation: champions 是直接對手，所以 against 最自然。
for 後面通常接獎項／資源，不接對手。
比賽尚未發生，不能預設勝出。
可描述面對某隊的表現，但不等於參賽。

exercises.original: She competed against athletes from twelve countries.
exercises.zh: 她與來自十二個國家的運動員競賽。
exercises.upgrade: She competed against athletes from twelve countries.

options.explanation: athletes 是對手，因此 against 正確。
後面應接 medal/title 等目標。
表示一起參與，沒有對抗。
意思是說服／贏得支持，或需要不同語境。

exercises.original: The startup must compete against much larger companies.
exercises.zh: 初創企業必須與規模大得多的公司競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The startup must compete against much larger companies.

options.explanation: larger companies 是直接競爭者。

words.example: Small businesses compete for customers in the local market.
words.exampleZh: 小型企業在本地市場爭取顧客。

exercises.original: Small businesses compete to attract the same customers.
exercises.zh: 小型企業爭取同一批顧客。
exercises.upgrade: Small businesses compete for the same customers.

options.explanation: customers 是大家爭取的有限市場資源。
against 後面應接對手，不是 customers 這個目標。
是為觀眾表演的結構，意思不同。

exercises.original: Universities compete to secure research funding.
exercises.zh: 大學爭取研究資金。
exercises.upgrade: Universities compete for research funding.

options.explanation: with 後面通常接競爭者。
只參與資助計劃不等於爭取。

exercises.original: Hundreds of applicants are competing to get ten places.
exercises.zh: 數百名申請人正爭奪十個名額。
exercises.upgrade: Hundreds of applicants are competing for ten places.

options.explanation: ten places 是有限名額，for 最精準。
against 要接對手，而不是名額。
不可能數百人都已勝出。

words.example: The young player is ready to challenge the defending champion.
words.exampleZh: 這名年輕球員準備挑戰衛冕冠軍。

exercises.original: The young player is ready to compete with the defending champion.
exercises.zh: 年輕球員準備挑戰衛冕冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: The young player is ready to challenge the defending champion.

options.explanation: defending champion 是現有強者，challenge 很自然。
只是一起參加，不表示向冠軍發起挑戰。
常指說服或贏得支持，不是這裡的競賽。

exercises.original: A smaller brand is beginning to compete seriously with the market leader.
exercises.zh: 較小品牌開始認真挑戰市場領導者。
exercises.upgrade: A smaller brand is beginning to challenge the market leader.

options.explanation: smaller brand 對 market leader 發起競爭，最貼切。

exercises.original: The opposition candidate is competing strongly against the incumbent.
exercises.zh: 反對派候選人正有力挑戰現任者。
exercises.upgrade: The opposition candidate is strongly challenging the incumbent.

options.explanation: incumbent 是現任領先者，challenge 表示爭取取代他。

words.example: The two brands will go head-to-head in the budget phone market.
words.exampleZh: 兩個品牌將在平價手機市場正面競爭。

exercises.original: The two brands will compete directly in the budget phone market.
exercises.zh: 兩個品牌將在平價手機市場正面競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The two brands will go head-to-head in the budget phone market.

options.explanation: two brands + directly 是典型正面競爭。
可能是消費者做的事，不是品牌互相競爭。
是反對提議，不是市場競爭。

exercises.original: The finalists will compete directly for the title tonight.
exercises.zh: 決賽選手今晚將正面交鋒爭奪冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: The finalists will go head-to-head for the title tonight.

options.explanation: finalists + direct final contest 最自然。

exercises.original: Two streaming services now compete directly for the same audience.
exercises.zh: 兩個串流平台現正為同一觀眾群正面競爭。
exercises.upgrade: Two streaming services now go head-to-head for the same audience.

options.explanation: exactly two rivals + same audience 支持直接正面競爭。

words.example: The two retailers are battling for market share.
words.exampleZh: 兩間零售商正在激烈爭奪市場份額。

exercises.original: The two retailers are competing intensely for market share.
exercises.zh: 兩間零售商正激烈爭奪市場份額。
exercises.upgrade: The two retailers are battling for market share.

options.explanation: intensely + market share 表示激烈商業競爭。

exercises.original: Three runners are competing fiercely for the lead.
exercises.zh: 三名跑手正激烈爭奪領先位置。
exercises.upgrade: Three runners are battling for the lead.

options.explanation: fiercely + the lead 是強烈競爭。

exercises.original: Airlines are competing hard for business travellers.
exercises.zh: 航空公司正激烈爭奪商務旅客。
exercises.upgrade: Airlines are battling for business travellers.

options.explanation: competing hard 支持更強烈的 battle for。

words.example: Tech firms are racing for leadership in artificial intelligence.
words.exampleZh: 科技公司正競逐人工智能領導地位。

exercises.original: Technology firms are competing quickly for leadership in the new market.
exercises.zh: 科技公司正迅速競逐新市場領導地位。
exercises.upgrade: Technology firms are racing for leadership in the new market.

options.explanation: quickly + leadership 加入速度與先機感。

exercises.original: Companies are competing to hire scarce AI specialists before rivals do.
exercises.zh: 公司正搶先競逐稀缺的人工智能專才。
exercises.upgrade: Companies are racing for scarce AI specialists before rivals do.

options.explanation: before rivals do 明確有搶先速度競爭。
不能說所有公司都已成功。

exercises.original: Several labs are competing to be first to develop the treatment.
exercises.zh: 多個實驗室正競逐率先研發療法。
exercises.upgrade: Several labs are racing to develop the treatment first.

options.explanation: be first 是 race 的直接線索。

words.example: Small firms must strive against larger competitors.
words.exampleZh: 小型公司必須奮力抗衡大型競爭者。

exercises.original: Small firms must compete hard against larger competitors.
exercises.zh: 小型公司必須奮力抗衡大型競爭者。
exercises.upgrade: Small firms must strive against larger competitors.

options.explanation: must + hard + larger competitors 強調持續努力抗衡。

exercises.original: Local producers compete against cheap imports to survive.
exercises.zh: 本地生產商必須抗衡廉價進口貨以生存。
exercises.upgrade: Local producers strive against cheap imports to survive.

options.explanation: to survive 表示長期奮力抗衡。

exercises.original: Independent shops compete continuously against national chains.
exercises.zh: 獨立商店持續抗衡全國連鎖店。
exercises.upgrade: Independent shops strive against national chains.

options.explanation: continuously + larger structural rivals 支持長期努力抗衡。
會變成已取得勝利的結果。

words.example: The company does not compete on price alone.
words.exampleZh: 這家公司並不單靠價格競爭。

exercises.original: The company competes by offering lower prices.
exercises.zh: 這家公司靠較低價格競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The company competes on price.

options.explanation: price 是競爭維度，on 正確。
for 要接競爭目標，不是維度。
可說 compare on price，但不是『以價格競爭』。
原句只說競爭方式，不表示已勝。

exercises.original: Some airlines compete mainly through service quality rather than cost.
exercises.zh: 部分航空公司主要靠服務質素而非成本競爭。
exercises.upgrade: Some airlines compete mainly on service quality rather than cost.

exercises.original: The retailer tries to compete through convenience and speed.
exercises.zh: 零售商嘗試靠便利和速度競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The retailer tries to compete on convenience and speed.

options.explanation: convenience and speed 是明確競爭因素。
應接 customers/market share 等目標。

words.example: Local shops struggle to compete with large online retailers.
words.exampleZh: 本地商店難以與大型網上零售商競爭。

exercises.original: Local shops struggle to compete against large online retailers.
exercises.zh: 本地商店難以與大型網上零售商競爭。
exercises.upgrade: Local shops struggle to compete with large online retailers.

options.explanation: 商業長期競爭關係中 with 很自然。
後面應接 customers/market share 等目標。

exercises.original: Domestic manufacturers compete against imported products.
exercises.zh: 本地製造商與進口產品競爭。
exercises.upgrade: Domestic manufacturers compete with imported products.

options.explanation: imported products 是市場上的替代／競爭者。

exercises.original: The service must compete against cheaper alternatives.
exercises.zh: 這項服務必須與更便宜的替代方案競爭。
exercises.upgrade: The service must compete with cheaper alternatives.

options.explanation: alternatives 是商業替代競爭對象，with 自然。

words.meaning: 有力競爭；仍有機會爭勝
words.example: Three teams remain in contention for the league title.
words.exampleZh: 仍有三支隊伍有力爭奪聯賽冠軍。

exercises.original: Three teams are still competing seriously for the league title.
exercises.zh: 仍有三支隊伍有力爭奪聯賽冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: Three teams remain in contention for the league title.

options.explanation: still + seriously for title 表示仍有實際爭勝機會。
所有參賽隊都參與，但未必仍有冠軍機會。

exercises.original: Only two candidates are now genuinely competing for first place.
exercises.zh: 現時只有兩名候選人真正有力爭第一。
exercises.upgrade: Only two candidates are now in contention for first place.

options.explanation: genuinely competing for first place 表示仍有現實勝算。
參與者可能很多，不代表有力爭勝。

exercises.original: After the defeat, the team is no longer competing for the championship.
exercises.zh: 落敗後，球隊已不再有力爭冠。
exercises.upgrade: After the defeat, the team is no longer in contention for the championship.

options.explanation: no longer + championship chance 是固定用法。
球隊仍可能繼續比賽，即使沒有奪冠機會。
不是這句要表達的狀態。

words.example: The smaller firm outcompeted larger rivals on customer service.
words.exampleZh: 這間較小公司靠客戶服務競爭勝過大型對手。

exercises.original: The smaller firm competed more successfully than larger rivals on customer service.
exercises.zh: 較小公司靠客戶服務競爭勝過大型對手。
exercises.upgrade: The smaller firm outcompeted larger rivals on customer service.

options.explanation: more successfully than 明確包含勝過對手的結果。
不表示競爭，更不表示勝過。
反對不等於市場上競爭勝出。
商業語境不自然，且不表示結果。

exercises.original: Local producers competed successfully against imports this year.
exercises.zh: 本地生產商今年成功競爭勝過進口貨。
exercises.upgrade: Local producers outcompeted imports this year.

options.explanation: successfully against 表示結果上勝過進口競爭。
只表示競爭過程，不保留 successfully 的勝出結果。

exercises.original: The new platform has competed more effectively than older services in attracting users.
exercises.zh: 新平台在吸引用戶方面競爭勝過舊服務。
exercises.upgrade: The new platform has outcompeted older services in attracting users.

options.explanation: more effectively than older services 明確表示競爭結果較成功。

falseSynonyms.zh: 勝出不等於 compete win 是競爭結果；compete 只表示參與競爭，未必勝出。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON To compete is to take part; to win is to succeed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 打鬥／爭鬥不等於所有 compete fight 可指身體衝突或激烈鬥爭；正常商業或體育競爭不一定是 fight。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Competition can be peaceful and rule-based; fighting implies conflict.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參賽／玩不等於 compete play 可指進行某項運動，但沒有必然『爭勝』含義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can play without competing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參與不等於競爭 participate 只表示參加；活動可以完全沒有競爭性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Participation does not necessarily involve rivalry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反對不等於 compete oppose 是反對某人／政策／提議；compete 是為同一目標或優勢而競爭。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Opposition is not necessarily competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 比較不等於 compete compare 是找相同與不同；compete 是試圖勝過或取得有限資源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comparing evaluates differences; competing seeks advantage or victory.

falseSynonyms.zh: 表現不等於 compete perform 指表現或演出；有人可以表現很好卻沒有參與競賽。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Performance can occur without competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: contest 作動詞可表示『質疑／爭辯』，也可表示爭奪，語義要小心 contest a decision 常是質疑；contest a seat 才可表示競逐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Contest has multiple senses, so its object determines whether it means compete.
